name: localstore
description: Local tool store with development capabilities

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n flask,vite -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.prod: npm run build && npm run prod:backend
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm ci && npm run build && rm -rf ../backend/static && mkdir -p ../backend/static && cp -r dist/* ../backend/static/
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && FLASK_DEBUG=1 FLASK_ENV=development python app.py
scripts.prod:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && FLASK_DEBUG=0 FLASK_ENV=production gunicorn -w 4 -b 127.0.0.1:8000 --timeout 120 --access-logfile - --error-logfile - app:app
scripts.test: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:backend
scripts.test:api: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python -m pytest tests/
